_comment: SECOND held-out set. WHY a second one: eval_heldout.json was used to justify FIELD_BOOST=0.20, and the intent patterns were then widened knowing which of its 19 cases were missed. That makes it a tuning set now, not a held-out one — the same trap that produced the fake MRR 1.000 on eval_set.json. These are fresh phrasings, written for linguistic variety rather than against the pattern list, over drugs verified present in the corpus. Report improvements on THIS file; eval_heldout.json is now only a regression check.
